insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput. This allows developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This change provides more flexibility in tracking shipments. The GraphQL Admin API has been updated to reflect this change, so developers should review their API calls to ensure compatibility. No migration is required, but developers should test their code to ensure it works as expected.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, improving their overall shipping experience.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the shipping experience for merchants and their customers, providing more accurate and detailed tracking information. It also gives developers more flexibility in handling shipments.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default --dev-origin for customer account push. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion, enhancing performance.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs, with OAuth state values now using cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit, and dependencies have been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing debugging capabilities.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Inventory management has been consolidated, with draft order and transfer/shipment inventory moving from reserved to committed, simplifying inventory tracking.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support has been added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores more seamlessly.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for easier deployment and testing of Hydrogen storefronts.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order management capabilities.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and new ShopifyQL schema for Shop Campaigns insights

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple patch updates were released for Hydrogen, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as new flags, HTTP/2 support, and secure OAuth state values. The skeleton and create-hydrogen tools now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

themes.title: ShopifyQL and Analytics
themes.detail: The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query Shop Campaigns performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
